note: Points de rupture : chefs des partis principaux et fondation du PPC (lignes d'événements des tableaux Wikipédia) ; campagnes : déclenchement et scrutin.

events.2017-03-18: Martine Ouellet is acclaimed leader of the Bloc Québécois (March 18, 2017)
events.2017-05-27: Andrew Scheer is elected leader of the Conservative Party of Canada (May 27, 2017)
events.2017-10-01: Jagmeet Singh is elected leader of the New Democratic Party (October 1, 2017)
events.2018-09-14: Maxime Bernier forms the People's Party of Canada following his resignation from the Conservative Party caucus (September 14, 2018)
events.2019-01-17: Yves-François Blanchet is acclaimed leader of the Bloc Québécois (January 17, 2019)
events.2020-08-24: August 24, 2020 Erin O'Toole is elected leader of the Conservative Party
events.2022-09-10: September 10, 2022 Pierre Poilievre is elected leader of the Conservative Party.
events.2025-03-09: March 9, 2025 Mark Carney is elected leader of the Liberal Party.
events.2026-03-29: March 29, 2026 Avi Lewis is elected as leader of the New Democratic Party.
